CompanyCareers

Why choose IMDT?

At IMDT we are driven to make the impossible possible by leveraging our extensive expertise in AI, deep learning, vision systems, IoT, and other cutting-edge technologies that are captivating imaginations all over the world today.

We make it happen because our team loves asking questions, brainstorming the answers together, and bringing solutions that make an impact and a difference.

From the first coffee we drink together in the morning to the last meeting of the workday, your days at IMDT will be filled with exciting challenges, groundbreaking developments, and a lot of inspiring energy from talented coworkers who have your back.

Isn’t time to make your career aspirations a reality?
